vulg: Paulus et Silvanus et Timotheus ecclesiae Thessalonicensium in Deo Patre et Domino Iesu Christo gratia vobis et pax
clem: Paulus, et Silvanus, et Timotheus ecclesi Thessalonicensium in Deo Patre, et Domino Jesu Christo.
tr: παυλος και σιλουανος και τιμοθεος τη εκκλησια θεσσαλονικεων εν θεω πατρι και κυριω ιησου χριστω χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: gratias agimus Deo semper pro omnibus vobis memoriam facientes in orationibus nostris sine intermissione
clem: Gratia vobis, et pax. Gratias agimus Deo semper pro omnibus vobis, memoriam vestri facientes in orationibus nostris sine intermissione,
tr: ευχαριστουμεν τω θεω παντοτε περι παντων υμων μνειαν υμων ποιουμενοι επι των προσευχων ημων
kjv: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

vulg: memores operis fidei vestrae et laboris et caritatis et sustinentiae spei Domini nostri Iesu Christi ante Deum et Patrem nostrum
clem: memores operis fidei vestr, et laboris, et caritatis, et sustinenti spei Domini nostri Jesu Christi, ante Deum et Patrem nostrum:
tr: αδιαλειπτως μνημονευοντες υμων του εργου της πιστεως και του κοπου της αγαπης και της υπομονης της ελπιδος του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου εμπροσθεν του θεου και πατρος ημων
kjv: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

vulg: scientes fratres dilecti a Deo electionem vestram
clem: scientes, fratres dilecti a Deo, electionem vestram:
tr: ειδοτες αδελφοι ηγαπημενοι υπο θεου την εκλογην υμων
kjv: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

vulg: quia evangelium nostrum non fuit ad vos in sermone tantum sed et in virtute et in Spiritu Sancto et in plenitudine multa sicut scitis quales fuerimus vobis propter vos
clem: quia Evangelium nostrum non fuit ad vos in sermone tantum, sed et in virtute, et in Spiritu Sancto, et in plenitudine multa, sicut scitis quales fuerimus in vobis propter vos.
tr: οτι το ευαγγελιον ημων ουκ εγενηθη εις υμας εν λογω μονον αλλα και εν δυναμει και εν πνευματι αγιω και εν πληροφορια πολλη καθως οιδατε οιοι εγενηθημεν εν υμιν δι υμας
kjv: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

vulg: et vos imitatores nostri facti estis et Domini excipientes verbum in tribulatione multa cum gaudio Spiritus Sancti
clem: Et vos imitatores nostri facti estis, et Domini, excipientes verbum in tribulatione multa, cum gaudio Spiritus Sancti:
tr: και υμεις μιμηται ημων εγενηθητε και του κυριου δεξαμενοι τον λογον εν θλιψει πολλη μετα χαρας πνευματος αγιου
kjv: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost.

vulg: ita ut facti sitis forma omnibus credentibus in Macedonia et in Achaia
clem: ita ut facti sitis forma omnibus credentibus in Macedonia, et in Achaia.
tr: ωστε γενεσθαι υμας τυπους πασιν τοις πιστευουσιν εν τη μακεδονια και τη αχαια
kjv: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

vulg: a vobis enim diffamatus est sermo Domini non solum in Macedonia et in Achaia sed in omni loco fides vestra quae est ad Deum profecta est ita ut non sit nobis necesse quicquam loqui
clem: A vobis enim diffamatus est sermo Domini, non solum in Macedonia, et in Achaia, sed et in omni loco fides vestra, qu est ad Deum, profecta est ita ut non sit nobis necesse quidquam loqui.
tr: αφ υμων γαρ εξηχηται ο λογος του κυριου ου μονον εν τη μακεδονια και αχαια αλλα και εν παντι τοπω η πιστις υμων η προς τον θεον εξεληλυθεν ωστε μη χρειαν ημας εχειν λαλειν τι
kjv: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

vulg: ipsi enim de nobis adnuntiant qualem introitum habuerimus ad vos et quomodo conversi estis ad Deum a simulacris servire Deo vivo et vero
clem: Ipsi enim de nobis annuntiant qualem introitum habuerimus ad vos: et quomodo conversi estis ad Deum a simulacris, servire Deo vivo, et vero,
tr: αυτοι γαρ περι ημων απαγγελλουσιν οποιαν εισοδον εχομεν  εσχομεν  προς υμας και πως επεστρεψατε προς τον θεον απο των ειδωλων δουλευειν θεω ζωντι και αληθινω
kjv: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

vulg: et expectare Filium eius de caelis quem suscitavit ex mortuis Iesum qui eripuit nos ab ira ventura
clem: et exspectare Filium ejus de clis (quem suscitavit a mortuis) Jesum, qui eripuit nos ab ira ventura.
tr: και αναμενειν τον υιον αυτου εκ των ουρανων ον ηγειρεν εκ νεκρων ιησουν τον ρυομενον ημας απο της οργης της ερχομενης
kjv: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

vulg: nam ipsi scitis fratres introitum nostrum ad vos quia non inanis fuit
clem: Nam ipsi scitis, fratres, introitum nostrum ad vos, quia non inanis fuit:
tr: αυτοι γαρ οιδατε αδελφοι την εισοδον ημων την προς υμας οτι ου κενη γεγονεν
kjv: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:

vulg: sed ante passi et contumeliis affecti sicut scitis in Philippis fiduciam habuimus in Deo nostro loqui ad vos evangelium Dei in multa sollicitudine
clem: sed ante passi, et contumeliis affecti (sicut scitis) in Philippis, fiduciam habuimus in Deo nostro, loqui ad vos Evangelium Dei in multa sollicitudine.
tr: αλλα και προπαθοντες και υβρισθεντες καθως οιδατε εν φιλιπποις επαρρησιασαμεθα εν τω θεω ημων λαλησαι προς υμας το ευαγγελιον του θεου εν πολλω αγωνι
kjv: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

vulg: exhortatio enim nostra non de errore neque de inmunditia neque in dolo
clem: Exhortatio enim nostra non de errore, neque de immunditia, neque in dolo,
tr: η γαρ παρακλησις ημων ουκ εκ πλανης ουδε εξ ακαθαρσιας ουτε εν δολω
kjv: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

vulg: sed sicut probati sumus a Deo ut crederetur nobis evangelium ita loquimur non quasi hominibus placentes sed Deo qui probat corda nostra
clem: sed sicut probati sumus a Deo ut crederetur nobis Evangelium: ita loquimur non quasi hominibus placentes, sed Deo, qui probat corda nostra.
tr: αλλα καθως δεδοκιμασμεθα υπο του θεου πιστευθηναι το ευαγγελιον ουτως λαλουμεν ουχ ως ανθρωποις αρεσκοντες αλλα τω θεω τω δοκιμαζοντι τας καρδιας ημων
kjv: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

vulg: neque enim aliquando fuimus in sermone adulationis sicut scitis neque in occasione avaritiae Deus testis est
clem: Neque enim aliquando fuimus in sermone adulationis, sicut scitis: neque in occasione avariti: Deus testis est:
tr: ουτε γαρ ποτε εν λογω κολακειας εγενηθημεν καθως οιδατε ουτε εν προφασει πλεονεξιας θεος μαρτυς
kjv: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:

vulg: nec quaerentes ab hominibus gloriam neque a vobis neque ab aliis
clem: nec qurentes ab hominibus gloriam, neque a vobis, neque ab aliis.
tr: ουτε ζητουντες εξ ανθρωπων δοξαν ουτε αφ υμων ουτε απ αλλων δυναμενοι εν βαρει ειναι ως χριστου αποστολοι
kjv: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

vulg: cum possimus oneri esse ut Christi apostoli sed facti sumus lenes in medio vestrum tamquam si nutrix foveat filios suos
clem: Cum possemus vobis oneri esse ut Christi apostoli: sed facti sumus parvuli in medio vestrum, tamquam si nutrix foveat filios suos.
tr: αλλ εγενηθημεν ηπιοι εν μεσω υμων ως αν τροφος θαλπη τα εαυτης τεκνα
kjv: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

vulg: ita desiderantes vos cupide volebamus tradere vobis non solum evangelium Dei sed etiam animas nostras quoniam carissimi nobis facti estis
clem: Ita desiderantes vos, cupide volebamus tradere vobis non solum Evangelium Dei, sed etiam animas nostras: quoniam carissimi nobis facti estis.
tr: ουτως ιμειρομενοι υμων ευδοκουμεν μεταδουναι υμιν ου μονον το ευαγγελιον του θεου αλλα και τας εαυτων ψυχας διοτι αγαπητοι ημιν γεγενησθε
kjv: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

vulg: memores enim estis fratres laborem nostrum et fatigationem nocte et die operantes ne quem vestrum gravaremus praedicavimus in vobis evangelium Dei
clem: Memores enim estis, fratres, laboris nostri, et fatigationis: nocte ac die operantes, ne quem vestrum gravaremus, prdicavimus in vobis Evangelium Dei.
tr: μνημονευετε γαρ αδελφοι τον κοπον ημων και τον μοχθον νυκτος γαρ και ημερας εργαζομενοι προς το μη επιβαρησαι τινα υμων εκηρυξαμεν εις υμας το ευαγγελιον του θεου
kjv: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

vulg: vos testes estis et Deus quam sancte et iuste et sine querella vobis qui credidistis fuimus
clem: Vos testes estis, et Deus, quam sancte, et juste, et sine querela, vobis, qui credidistis, fuimus:
tr: υμεις μαρτυρες και ο θεος ως οσιως και δικαιως και αμεμπτως υμιν τοις πιστευουσιν εγενηθημεν
kjv: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

vulg: sicut scitis qualiter unumquemque vestrum tamquam pater filios suos
clem: sicut scitis, qualiter unumquemque vestrum (sicut pater filios suos)
tr: καθαπερ οιδατε ως ενα εκαστον υμων ως πατηρ τεκνα εαυτου παρακαλουντες υμας και παραμυθουμενοι (2:12) και μαρτυρουμενοι
kjv: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,

vulg: deprecantes vos et consolantes testificati sumus ut ambularetis digne Deo qui vocavit vos in suum regnum et gloriam
clem: deprecantes vos, et consolantes, testificati sumus, ut ambularetis digne Deo, qui vocavit vos in suum regnum et gloriam.
tr: εις το περιπατησαι υμας αξιως του θεου του καλουντος υμας εις την εαυτου βασιλειαν και δοξαν
kjv: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

vulg: ideo et nos gratias agimus Deo sine intermissione quoniam cum accepissetis a nobis verbum auditus Dei accepistis non ut verbum hominum sed sicut est vere verbum Dei qui operatur in vobis qui credidistis
clem: Ideo et nos gratias agimus Deo sine intermissione: quoniam cum accepissetis a nobis verbum auditus Dei, accepistis illud, non ut verbum hominum, sed (sicut est vere) verbum Dei, qui operatur in vobis, qui credidistis:
tr: δια τουτο και ημεις ευχαριστουμεν τω θεω αδιαλειπτως οτι παραλαβοντες λογον ακοης παρ ημων του θεου εδεξασθε ου λογον ανθρωπων αλλα καθως εστιν αληθως λογον θεου ος και ενεργειται εν υμιν τοις πιστευουσιν
kjv: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

vulg: vos enim imitatores facti estis fratres ecclesiarum Dei quae sunt in Iudaea in Christo Iesu quia eadem passi estis et vos a contribulibus vestris sicut et ipsi a Iudaeis
clem: vos enim imitatores facti estis, fratres, ecclesiarum Dei, qu sunt in Juda in Christo Jesu: quia eadem passi estis et vos a contribulibus vestris, sicut et ipsi a Judis:
tr: υμεις γαρ μιμηται εγενηθητε αδελφοι των εκκλησιων του θεου των ουσων εν τη ιουδαια εν χριστω ιησου οτι ταυτα επαθετε και υμεις υπο των ιδιων συμφυλετων καθως και αυτοι υπο των ιουδαιων
kjv: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

vulg: qui et Dominum occiderunt Iesum et prophetas et nos persecuti sunt et Deo non placent et omnibus hominibus adversantur
clem: qui et Dominum occiderunt Jesum, et prophetas, et nos persecuti sunt, et Deo non placent, et omnibus hominibus adversantur,
tr: των και τον κυριον αποκτειναντων ιησουν και τους ιδιους προφητας και υμας  ημας  εκδιωξαντων και θεω μη αρεσκοντων και πασιν ανθρωποις εναντιων
kjv: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

vulg: prohibentes nos gentibus loqui ut salvae fiant ut impleant peccata sua semper praevenit autem ira Dei super illos usque in finem
clem: prohibentes nos gentibus loqui ut salv fiant, ut impleant peccata sua semper: pervenit enim ira Dei super illos usque in finem.
tr: κωλυοντων ημας τοις εθνεσιν λαλησαι ινα σωθωσιν εις το αναπληρωσαι αυτων τας αμαρτιας παντοτε εφθασεν δε επ αυτους η οργη εις τελος
kjv: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

vulg: nos autem fratres desolati a vobis ad tempus horae aspectu non corde abundantius festinavimus faciem vestram videre cum multo desiderio
clem: Nos autem fratres desolati a vobis ad tempus hor, aspectu, non corde, abundantius festinavimus faciem vestram videre cum multo desiderio:
tr: ημεις δε αδελφοι απορφανισθεντες αφ υμων προς καιρον ωρας προσωπω ου καρδια περισσοτερως εσπουδασαμεν το προσωπον υμων ιδειν εν πολλη επιθυμια
kjv: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

vulg: quoniam voluimus venire ad vos ego quidem Paulus et semel et iterum et inpedivit nos Satanas
clem: quoniam voluimus venire ad vos, ego quidem Paulus, et semel, et iterum: sed impedivit nos Satanas.
tr: διο ηθελησαμεν ελθειν προς υμας εγω μεν παυλος και απαξ και δις και ενεκοψεν ημας ο σατανας
kjv: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

vulg: quae est enim nostra spes aut gaudium aut corona gloriae nonne vos ante Dominum nostrum Iesum estis in adventu eius
clem: Qu est enim nostra spes aut gaudium, aut corona glori? nonne vos ante Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum estis in adventu ejus?
tr: τις γαρ ημων ελπις η χαρα η στεφανος καυχησεως η ουχι και υμεις εμπροσθεν του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου εν τη αυτου παρουσια
kjv: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

vulg: vos enim estis gloria nostra et gaudium
clem: vos enim estis gloria nostra et gaudium.
tr: υμεις γαρ εστε η δοξα ημων και η χαρα
kjv: For ye are our glory and joy.

vulg: propter quod non sustinentes amplius placuit nobis remanere Athenis solis
clem: Propter quod non sustinentes amplius, placuit nobis remanere Athenis, solis:
tr: διο μηκετι στεγοντες ευδοκησαμεν καταλειφθηναι εν αθηναις μονοι
kjv: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

vulg: et misimus Timotheum fratrem nostrum et ministrum Dei in evangelio Christi ad confirmandos vos et exhortandos pro fide vestra
clem: et misimus Timotheum fratrem nostrum, et ministrum Dei in Evangelio Christi, ad confirmandos vos, et exhortandos pro fide vestra:
tr: και επεμψαμεν τιμοθεον τον αδελφον ημων και διακονον του θεου και συνεργον ημων εν τω ευαγγελιω του χριστου εις το στηριξαι υμας και παρακαλεσαι υμας περι της πιστεως υμων
kjv: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

vulg: ut nemo moveatur in tribulationibus istis ipsi enim scitis quod in hoc positi sumus
clem: ut nemo moveatur in tribulationibus istis: ipsi enim scitis quod in hoc positi sumus.
tr: τω μηδενα σαινεσθαι εν ταις θλιψεσιν ταυταις αυτοι γαρ οιδατε οτι εις τουτο κειμεθα
kjv: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

vulg: nam et cum apud vos essemus praedicebamus vobis passuros nos tribulationes sicut et factum est et scitis
clem: Nam et cum apud vos essemus, prdicebamus vobis passuros nos tribulationes, sicut et factum est, et scitis.
tr: και γαρ οτε προς υμας ημεν προελεγομεν υμιν οτι μελλομεν θλιβεσθαι καθως και εγενετο και οιδατε
kjv: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

vulg: propterea et ego amplius non sustinens misi ad cognoscendam fidem vestram ne forte temptaverit vos is qui temptat et inanis fiat labor noster
clem: Propterea et ego amplius non sustinens, misi ad cognoscendam fidem vestram: ne forte tentaverit vos is qui tentat, et inanis fiat labor noster.
tr: δια τουτο καγω μηκετι στεγων επεμψα εις το γνωναι την πιστιν υμων μηπως επειρασεν υμας ο πειραζων και εις κενον γενηται ο κοπος ημων
kjv: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

vulg: nunc autem veniente Timotheo ad nos a vobis et adnuntiante nobis fidem et caritatem vestram et quia memoriam nostri habetis bonam semper desiderantes nos videre sicut nos quoque vos
clem: Nunc autem veniente Timotheo ad nos a vobis, et annuntiante nobis fidem et caritatem vestram, et quia memoriam nostri habetis bonam semper, desiderantes nos videre, sicut et nos quoque vos:
tr: αρτι δε ελθοντος τιμοθεου προς ημας αφ υμων και ευαγγελισαμενου ημιν την πιστιν και την αγαπην υμων και οτι εχετε μνειαν ημων αγαθην παντοτε επιποθουντες ημας ιδειν καθαπερ και ημεις υμας
kjv: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

vulg: ideo consolati sumus fratres in vobis in omni necessitate et tribulatione nostra per vestram fidem
clem: ideo consolati sumus, fratres, in vobis in omni necessitate et tribulatione nostra, per fidem vestram,
tr: δια τουτο παρεκληθημεν αδελφοι εφ υμιν επι παση τη θλιψει και αναγκη ημων δια της υμων πιστεως
kjv: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

vulg: quoniam nunc vivimus si vos statis in Domino
clem: quoniam nunc vivimus, si vos statis in Domino.
tr: οτι νυν ζωμεν εαν υμεις στηκητε εν κυριω
kjv: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

vulg: quam enim gratiarum actionem possumus Deo retribuere pro vobis in omni gaudio quo gaudemus propter vos ante Deum nostrum
clem: Quam enim gratiarum actionem possumus Deo retribuere pro vobis in omni gaudio, quo gaudemus propter vos ante Deum nostrum,
tr: τινα γαρ ευχαριστιαν δυναμεθα τω θεω ανταποδουναι περι υμων επι παση τη χαρα η χαιρομεν δι υμας εμπροσθεν του θεου ημων
kjv: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

vulg: nocte et die abundantius orantes ut videamus faciem vestram et conpleamus ea quae desunt fidei vestrae
clem: nocte ac die abundantius orantes, ut videamus faciem vestram, et compleamus ea qu desunt fidei vestr?
tr: νυκτος και ημερας υπερ εκπερισσου  υπερ εκ περισσου  δεομενοι εις το ιδειν υμων το προσωπον και καταρτισαι τα υστερηματα της πιστεως υμων
kjv: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

vulg: ipse autem Deus et Pater noster et Dominus Iesus dirigat viam nostram ad vos
clem: Ipse autem Deus, et Pater noster, et Dominus noster Jesus Christus, dirigat viam nostram ad vos.
tr: αυτος δε ο θεος και πατηρ ημων και ο κυριος ημων ιησους χριστος κατευθυναι την οδον ημων προς υμας
kjv: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

vulg: vos autem Dominus multiplicet et abundare faciat caritatem in invicem et in omnes quemadmodum et nos in vobis
clem: Vos autem Dominus multiplicet, et abundare faciat caritatem vestram in invicem, et in omnes, quemadmodum et nos in vobis:
tr: υμας δε ο κυριος πλεονασαι και περισσευσαι τη αγαπη εις αλληλους και εις παντας καθαπερ και ημεις εις υμας
kjv: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

vulg: ad confirmanda corda vestra sine querella in sanctitate ante Deum et Patrem nostrum in adventu Domini nostri Iesu cum omnibus sanctis eius amen
clem: ad confirmanda corda vestra sine querela in sanctitate, ante Deum et Patrem nostrum, in adventu Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum omnibus sanctis ejus. Amen.
tr: εις το στηριξαι υμων τας καρδιας αμεμπτους εν αγιωσυνη εμπροσθεν του θεου και πατρος ημων εν τη παρουσια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα παντων των αγιων αυτου
kjv: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

vulg: de cetero ergo fratres rogamus vos et obsecramus in Domino Iesu ut quemadmodum accepistis a nobis quomodo vos oporteat ambulare et placere Deo sicut et ambulatis ut abundetis magis
clem: De cetero ergo, fratres, rogamus vos et obsecramus in Domino Jesu, ut quemadmodum accepistis a nobis quomodo oporteat vos ambulare, et placere Deo, sic et ambuletis ut abundetis magis.
tr: το λοιπον ουν αδελφοι ερωτωμεν υμας και παρακαλουμεν εν κυριω ιησου καθως παρελαβετε παρ ημων το πως δει υμας περιπατειν και αρεσκειν θεω ινα περισσευητε μαλλον
kjv: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

vulg: scitis enim quae praecepta dederimus vobis per Dominum Iesum
clem: Scitis enim qu prcepta dederim vobis per Dominum Jesum.
tr: οιδατε γαρ τινας παραγγελιας εδωκαμεν υμιν δια του κυριου ιησου
kjv: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

vulg: haec est enim voluntas Dei sanctificatio vestra
clem: Hc est enim voluntas Dei, sanctificatio vestra: ut abstineatis vos a fornicatione,
tr: τουτο γαρ εστιν θελημα του θεου ο αγιασμος υμων απεχεσθαι υμας απο της πορνειας
kjv: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

vulg: ut abstineatis vos a fornicatione ut sciat unusquisque vestrum suum vas possidere in sanctificatione et honore
clem: ut sciat unusquisque vestrum vas suum possidere in sanctificatione, et honore:
tr: ειδεναι εκαστον υμων το εαυτου σκευος κτασθαι εν αγιασμω και τιμη
kjv: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

vulg: non in passione desiderii sicut et gentes quae ignorant Deum
clem: non in passione desiderii, sicut et gentes, qu ignorant Deum:
tr: μη εν παθει επιθυμιας καθαπερ και τα εθνη τα μη ειδοτα τον θεον
kjv: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

vulg: ut ne quis supergrediatur neque circumveniat in negotio fratrem suum quoniam vindex est Dominus de his omnibus sicut et praediximus vobis et testificati sumus
clem: et ne quis supergrediatur, neque circumveniat in negotio fratrem suum: quoniam vindex est Dominus de his omnibus, sicut prdiximus vobis, et testificati sumus.
tr: το μη υπερβαινειν και πλεονεκτειν εν τω πραγματι τον αδελφον αυτου διοτι εκδικος ο κυριος περι παντων τουτων καθως και προειπαμεν υμιν και διεμαρτυραμεθα
kjv: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

vulg: non enim vocavit nos Deus in inmunditia sed in sanctificatione
clem: Non enim vocavit nos Deus in immunditiam, sed in sanctificationem.
tr: ου γαρ εκαλεσεν ημας ο θεος επι ακαθαρσια αλλ εν αγιασμω
kjv: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

vulg: itaque qui spernit non hominem spernit sed Deum qui etiam dedit Spiritum suum Sanctum in vobis
clem: Itaque qui hc spernit, non hominem spernit, sed Deum: qui etiam dedit Spiritum suum Sanctum in nobis.
tr: τοιγαρουν ο αθετων ουκ ανθρωπον αθετει αλλα τον θεον τον και δοντα το πνευμα αυτου το αγιον εις ημας
kjv: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

vulg: de caritate autem fraternitatis non necesse habemus scribere vobis ipsi enim vos a Deo didicistis ut diligatis invicem
clem: De caritate autem fraternitatis non necesse habemus scribere vobis: ipsi enim vos a Deo didicistis ut diligatis invicem.
tr: περι δε της φιλαδελφιας ου χρειαν εχετε γραφειν υμιν αυτοι γαρ υμεις θεοδιδακτοι εστε εις το αγαπαν αλληλους
kjv: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

vulg: etenim facitis illud in omnes fratres in universa Macedonia rogamus autem vos fratres ut abundetis magis
clem: Etenim illud facitis in omnes fratres in universa Macedonia. Rogamus autem vos, fratres, ut abundetis magis,
tr: και γαρ ποιειτε αυτο εις παντας τους αδελφους τους εν ολη τη μακεδονια παρακαλουμεν δε υμας αδελφοι περισσευειν μαλλον
kjv: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

vulg: et operam detis ut quieti sitis et ut vestrum negotium agatis et operemini manibus vestris sicut praecepimus vobis
clem: et opera detis ut quieti sitis, et ut vestrum negotium agatis, et operemini manibus vestris, sicut prcepimus vobis:
tr: και φιλοτιμεισθαι ησυχαζειν και πρασσειν τα ιδια και εργαζεσθαι ταις ιδιαις χερσιν υμων καθως υμιν παρηγγειλαμεν
kjv: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

vulg: et ut honeste ambuletis ad eos qui foris sunt et nullius aliquid desideretis
clem: et ut honeste ambuletis ad eos qui foris sunt: et nullius aliquid desideretis.
tr: ινα περιπατητε ευσχημονως προς τους εξω και μηδενος χρειαν εχητε
kjv: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

vulg: nolumus autem vos ignorare fratres de dormientibus ut non contristemini sicut et ceteri qui spem non habent
clem: Nolumus autem vos ignorare fratres de dormientibus, ut non contristemini sicut et ceteri, qui spem non habent.
tr: ου θελω δε υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι περι των κεκοιμημενων ινα μη λυπησθε καθως και οι λοιποι οι μη εχοντες ελπιδα
kjv: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

vulg: si enim credimus quod Iesus mortuus est et resurrexit ita et Deus eos qui dormierunt per Iesum adducet cum eo
clem: Si enim credimus quod Jesus mortuus est, et resurrexit: ita et Deus eos qui dormierunt per Jesum, adducet cum eo.
tr: ει γαρ πιστευομεν οτι ιησους απεθανεν και ανεστη ουτως και ο θεος τους κοιμηθεντας δια του ιησου αξει συν αυτω
kjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

vulg: hoc enim vobis dicimus in verbo Domini quia nos qui vivimus qui residui sumus in adventum Domini non praeveniemus eos qui dormierunt
clem: Hoc enim vobis dicimus in verbo Domini, quia nos, qui vivimus, qui residui sumus in adventum Domini, non prveniemus eos qui dormierunt.
tr: τουτο γαρ υμιν λεγομεν εν λογω κυριου οτι ημεις οι ζωντες οι περιλειπομενοι εις την παρουσιαν του κυριου ου μη φθασωμεν τους κοιμηθεντας
kjv: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

vulg: quoniam ipse Dominus in iussu et in voce archangeli et in tuba Dei descendet de caelo et mortui qui in Christo sunt resurgent primi
clem: Quoniam ipse Dominus in jussu, et in voce archangeli, et in tuba Dei descendet de clo: et mortui, qui in Christo sunt, resurgent primi.
tr: οτι αυτος ο κυριος εν κελευσματι εν φωνη αρχαγγελου και εν σαλπιγγι θεου καταβησεται απ ουρανου και οι νεκροι εν χριστω αναστησονται πρωτον
kjv: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

vulg: deinde nos qui vivimus qui relinquimur simul rapiemur cum illis in nubibus obviam Domino in aera et sic semper cum Domino erimus
clem: Deinde nos, qui vivimus, qui relinquimur, simul rapiemur cum illis in nubibus obviam Christo in ara, et sic semper cum Domino erimus.
tr: επειτα ημεις οι ζωντες οι περιλειπομενοι αμα συν αυτοις αρπαγησομεθα εν νεφελαις εις απαντησιν του κυριου εις αερα και ουτως παντοτε συν κυριω εσομεθα
kjv: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

vulg: itaque consolamini invicem in verbis istis
clem: Itaque consolamini invicem in verbis istis.
tr: ωστε παρακαλειτε αλληλους εν τοις λογοις τουτοις
kjv: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

vulg: de temporibus autem et momentis fratres non indigetis ut scribamus vobis
clem: De temporibus autem, et momentis, fratres, non indigetis ut scribamus vobis.
tr: περι δε των χρονων και των καιρων αδελφοι ου χρειαν εχετε υμιν γραφεσθαι
kjv: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

vulg: ipsi enim diligenter scitis quia dies Domini sicut fur in nocte ita veniet
clem: Ipsi enim diligenter scitis quia dies Domini, sicut fur in nocte, ita veniet:
tr: αυτοι γαρ ακριβως οιδατε οτι η ημερα κυριου ως κλεπτης εν νυκτι ουτως ερχεται
kjv: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

vulg: cum enim dixerint pax et securitas tunc repentinus eis superveniet interitus sicut dolor in utero habenti et non effugient
clem: cum enim dixerint, Pax et securitas: tunc repentius eis superveniet interitus, sicut dolor in utero habenti, et non effugient.
tr: οταν γαρ λεγωσιν ειρηνη και ασφαλεια τοτε αιφνιδιος αυτοις εφισταται ολεθρος ωσπερ η ωδιν τη εν γαστρι εχουση και ου μη εκφυγωσιν
kjv: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

vulg: vos autem fratres non estis in tenebris ut vos dies ille tamquam fur conprehendat
clem: Vos autem, fratres, non estis in tenebris, ut vos die illa tamquam fur comprehendat:
tr: υμεις δε αδελφοι ουκ εστε εν σκοτει ινα η ημερα υμας ως κλεπτης καταλαβη
kjv: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

vulg: omnes enim vos filii lucis estis et filii diei non sumus noctis neque tenebrarum
clem: omnes enim vos filii lucis estis, et filii diei: non sumus noctis, neque tenebrarum.
tr: παντες υμεις υιοι φωτος εστε και υιοι ημερας ουκ εσμεν νυκτος ουδε σκοτους
kjv: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

vulg: igitur non dormiamus sicut ceteri sed vigilemus et sobrii simus
clem: Igitur non dormiamus sicut et ceteri, sed vigilemus, et sobrii simus.
tr: αρα ουν μη καθευδωμεν ως και οι λοιποι αλλα γρηγορωμεν και νηφωμεν
kjv: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

vulg: qui enim dormiunt nocte dormiunt et qui ebrii sunt nocte ebrii sunt
clem: Qui enim dormiunt, nocte dormiunt: et qui ebrii sunt, nocte ebrii sunt.
tr: οι γαρ καθευδοντες νυκτος καθευδουσιν και οι μεθυσκομενοι νυκτος μεθυουσιν
kjv: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

vulg: nos autem qui diei sumus sobrii simus induti loricam fidei et caritatis et galeam spem salutis
clem: Nos autem, qui diei sumus, sobrii simus, induti loricam fidei et caritatis, et galeam spem salutis:
tr: ημεις δε ημερας οντες νηφωμεν ενδυσαμενοι θωρακα πιστεως και αγαπης και περικεφαλαιαν ελπιδα σωτηριας
kjv: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

vulg: quoniam non posuit nos Deus in iram sed in adquisitionem salutis per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum
clem: quoniam non posuit nos Deus in iram, sed in acquisitionem salutis per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum,
tr: οτι ουκ εθετο ημας ο θεος εις οργην αλλ εις περιποιησιν σωτηριας δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
kjv: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

vulg: qui mortuus est pro nobis ut sive vigilemus sive dormiamus simul cum illo vivamus
clem: qui mortuus est pro nobis: ut sive vigilemus, sive dormiamus, simul cum illo vivamus.
tr: του αποθανοντος υπερ ημων ινα ειτε γρηγορωμεν ειτε καθευδωμεν αμα συν αυτω ζησωμεν
kjv: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

vulg: propter quod consolamini invicem et aedificate alterutrum sicut et facitis
clem: Propter quod consolamini invicem, et dificate alterutrum, sicut et facitis.
tr: διο παρακαλειτε αλληλους και οικοδομειτε εις τον ενα καθως και ποιειτε
kjv: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

vulg: rogamus autem vos fratres ut noveritis eos qui laborant inter vos et praesunt vobis in Domino et monent vos
clem: Rogamus autem vos, fratres, ut noveritis eos qui laborant inter vos, et prsunt vobis in Domino, et monent vos,
tr: ερωτωμεν δε υμας αδελφοι ειδεναι τους κοπιωντας εν υμιν και προισταμενους υμων εν κυριω και νουθετουντας υμας
kjv: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

vulg: ut habeatis illos abundantius in caritate propter opus illorum pacem habete cum eis
clem: ut habeatis illos abundantius in caritate propter opus illorum: pacem habete cum eis.
tr: και ηγεισθαι αυτους υπερ εκπερισσου  υπερ εκ περισσου  εν αγαπη δια το εργον αυτων ειρηνευετε εν εαυτοις
kjv: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

vulg: rogamus autem vos fratres corripite inquietos consolamini pusillianimes suscipite infirmos patientes estote ad omnes
clem: Rogamus autem vos, fratres, corripite inquietos, consolamini pusillanimes, suscipite infirmos, patientes estote ad omnes.
tr: παρακαλουμεν δε υμας αδελφοι νουθετειτε τους ατακτους παραμυθεισθε τους ολιγοψυχους αντεχεσθε των ασθενων μακροθυμειτε προς παντας
kjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

vulg: videte ne quis malum pro malo alicui reddat sed semper quod bonum est sectamini et in invicem et in omnes
clem: Videte ne quis malum pro malo alicui reddat: sed semper quod bonum est sectamini in invicem, et in omnes.
tr: ορατε μη τις κακον αντι κακου τινι αποδω αλλα παντοτε το αγαθον διωκετε και εις αλληλους και εις παντας
kjv: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

vulg: semper gaudete
clem: Semper gaudete.
tr: παντοτε χαιρετε
kjv: Rejoice evermore.

vulg: sine intermissione orate
clem: Sine intermissione orate.
tr: αδιαλειπτως προσευχεσθε
kjv: Pray without ceasing.

vulg: in omnibus gratias agite haec enim voluntas Dei est in Christo Iesu in omnibus vobis
clem: In omnibus gratias agite: hc est enim voluntas Dei in Christo Jesu in omnibus vobis.
tr: εν παντι ευχαριστειτε τουτο γαρ θελημα θεου εν χριστω ιησου εις υμας
kjv: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

vulg: Spiritum nolite extinguere
clem: Spiritum nolite extinguere.
tr: το πνευμα μη σβεννυτε
kjv: Quench not the Spirit.

vulg: prophetias nolite spernere
clem: Prophetias nolite spernere.
tr: προφητειας μη εξουθενειτε
kjv: Despise not prophesyings.

vulg: omnia autem probate quod bonum est tenete
clem: Omnia autem probate: quod bonum est tenete.
tr: παντα δοκιμαζετε το καλον κατεχετε
kjv: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

vulg: ab omni specie mala abstinete vos
clem: Ab omni specie mala abstinete vos.
tr: απο παντος ειδους πονηρου απεχεσθε
kjv: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

vulg: ipse autem Deus pacis sanctificet vos per omnia et integer spiritus vester et anima et corpus sine querella in adventu Domini nostri Iesu Christi servetur
clem: Ipse autem Deus pacis sanctificet vos per omnia: ut integer spiritus vester, et anima, et corpus sine querela in adventu Domini nostri Jesu Christi servetur.
tr: αυτος δε ο θεος της ειρηνης αγιασαι υμας ολοτελεις και ολοκληρον υμων το πνευμα και η ψυχη και το σωμα αμεμπτως εν τη παρουσια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου τηρηθειη
kjv: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: fidelis est qui vocavit vos qui etiam faciet
clem: Fidelis est, qui vocavit vos: qui etiam faciet.
tr: πιστος ο καλων υμας ος και ποιησει
kjv: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

vulg: fratres orate pro nobis
clem: Fratres, orate pro nobis.
tr: αδελφοι προσευχεσθε περι ημων
kjv: Brethren, pray for us.

vulg: salutate fratres omnes in osculo sancto
clem: Salutate fratres omnes in osculo sancto.
tr: ασπασασθε τους αδελφους παντας εν φιληματι αγιω
kjv: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

vulg: adiuro vos per Dominum ut legatur epistula omnibus sanctis fratribus
clem: Adjuro vos per Dominum ut legatur epistola hc omnibus sanctis fratribus.
tr: ορκιζω υμας τον κυριον αναγνωσθηναι την επιστολην πασιν τοις αγιοις αδελφοις
kjv: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

vulg: gratia Domini nostri Iesu Christi vobiscum amen
clem: Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi vobiscum. Amen.
tr: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μεθ υμων αμην [ προς θεσσαλονικεις πρωτη εγραφη απο αθηνων]
kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
